SELECT i.ITEM_ID as itemId, i.BOARD_ID as boardId, i.CONTENT as title, i.DESCRIPTION as description, i.STATUS as status, i.PRIORITY as priority, i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME as assigneeUsername, isa.ASSIGNED_BY as assignedByUsername, i.REQUEST_DATE as requestDate, i.DUE_DATE as dueDate, i.PARENT_ITEM_ID as parentItemId, i.ITEM_DEPTH as itemDepth, i.CHILD_SORT_ORDER as childSortOrder, i.SORT_ORDER as sortOrder, i.CREATED_AT as createdAt, b.BOARD_NAME as boardName, b.OWNER_USERNAME as boardOwnerUsername, uo.NAME as boardOwnerName, ua.NAME as assigneeName, uab.NAME as assignedByUserName, pi.CONTENT as parentTitle, -- 보드 공유 여부 (보드 소유자가 아닌 경우) CASE WHEN b.OWNER_USERNAME != #{username} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isBoardShared, -- 보드 공유해준 사용자명 (보드 소유자) CASE WHEN b.OWNER_USERNAME != #{username} THEN uo.NAME ELSE NULL END as sharedByUserName, -- 배당받은 업무 여부 (TB_ITEM_SHARE에서 ASSIGN 타입으로 공유받은 경우) CASE WHEN isa.ITEM_SHARE_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isAssignedToMe FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER uo ON b.OWNER_USERNAME = uo.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER ua ON i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = ua.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_ITEM_SHARE isa ON i.ITEM_ID = isa.ITEM_ID AND isa.USERNAME = #{username} AND isa.SHARE_TYPE = 'ASSIGN' AND isa.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_USER uab ON isa.ASSIGNED_BY = uab.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_ITEM pi ON i.PARENT_ITEM_ID = pi.ITEM_ID WHERE b.USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( b.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BOARD_SHARE bs WHERE bs.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID AND bs.USERNAME = #{username} AND bs.DELETED_AT IS NULL ) )
AND i.BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
AND ( (i.REQUEST_DATE IS NOT NULL AND i.REQUEST_DATE <= #{endDate}) OR (i.DUE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND i.DUE_DATE >= #{startDate}) OR (i.REQUEST_DATE IS NULL AND i.DUE_DATE IS NULL) )
AND i.STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED')
AND i.STATUS != 'DELETED'
ORDER BY COALESCE(i.PARENT_ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_ID), i.ITEM_DEPTH, i.CHILD_SORT_ORDER, i.SORT_ORDER, i.CREATED_AT

SELECT p.PROPERTY_ID as propertyId, p.PROPERTY_NAME as propertyName, p.PROPERTY_TYPE as propertyType, p.OWNER_TYPE as ownerType, p.USE_YN as useYn FROM TB_PROPERTY_DEF p WHERE p.PROPERTY_NAME = '시작일' AND p.PROPERTY_TYPE = 'DATE' AND p.USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
